primary_target: current manipulation subject; holding a bowl does not mean no target
separate_goal: recipient region is separately unknown, not a negative subject label

development_objective.recall_requirement: no lower than same-protocol original pointer at chosen coverage
development_objective.critical_role_coverage: For each dev role with >=3 visible samples, retain at least one correct accepted box; report per-role recall and rejection, do not pass by rejecting an entire interaction role

statistics: weak geometry/intent proxies, not human intention GT or policy success; report precision and recall with coverage and episode grouping
training: original train episodes only; all hyperparameter/checkpoint/threshold choices on original dev
regression: old test plus the eight previously examined stage-pilot episodes are now regression, not fresh holdout
confirmation: freeze another eight non-overlapping valid-source episodes before fitting; inspect after dev selection
methods: label confidence weighting and oracle upper bounds
robot FK and observed depth geometry with explicit measured torso joint input
dense original train/dev sequences; second independent confirmation
deployment: do not replace production model based only on weak-proxy scores; retain causal inputs, missing-target masks and full-scene observations

dense_development_objective.recall_requirement: at least frozen baseline on the same dense dev
dense_development_objective.role_recall_requirement: at least baseline minus .05 for each role with >=10 visible samples; every role with >=3 visible retains >=1 correct accepted target
dense_development_objective.timing: strengthened before dense training and before second confirmation evaluation
